round2_fix.implementation_note: the fix is more than one line ON PURPOSE: the review's suggested one-liner (compare the record's commitment) is necessary but cannot be OBSERVED on a real artifact, because a real record's commitment always equals its own projection. run_forecast therefore also exports result['payload_sha256'], which is excluded from the projection (otherwise it would be self-referential), and the verifier checks BOTH statements. That is what makes 'tamper a real artifact and see [E16]' an actual test rather than a tautology.
